title: Super admin console uses the backend, OpenNext build, no tracked credentials; desktop super-admin pages removed
goal: Make the operator console a thin, secure client of the backend that can be built and deployed one way, and remove the duplicate console from the agency desktop app.
why: super-admin/wrangler.toml tracks a placeholder JWT secret and default super admin email/password; code falls back to the same defaults (src/middleware.ts:4, src/lib/session.ts, src/app/api/auth/route.ts, src/app/api/auth/seed/route.ts); /api/auth/seed is public; the middleware lets any path containing a dot skip auth; code uses @opennextjs/cloudflare while CI, terraform and root scripts use next-on-pages; the Razorpay webhook skips signature checks; announcements, support and SEO pages are mock or unread; the desktop app has its own read-only /super-admin pages.
steps: Delete super-admin/src/app/api/auth/seed/ and super-admin/src/app/api/webhooks/razorpay/ (billing webhooks move to the backend in R205). Remove [vars] secrets from super-admin/wrangler.toml (keep non-secret ENVIRONMENT and BACKEND_API_URL); add super-admin/.dev.vars.example listing SUPER_ADMIN_JWT_SECRET and BACKEND_API_URL names only. Remove every literal fallback secret/credential in src (grep for SuperAdmin@123, change-this, super-admin-dev-secret); missing secret -> the app returns 500 with a clear log line, never a default.

src/lib/backend.ts: backendFetch(path, init) server-side helper that forwards the sa_token cookie value as Authorization: Bearer to `${BACKEND_API_URL}/admin/...` and maps the backend envelope { success, data, error }.

Login: src/app/api/auth/route.ts posts to backend /admin/auth/login and stores the returned JWT in the httpOnly, Secure (except localhost), SameSite=Strict sa_token cookie; middleware.ts verifies it with SUPER_ADMIN_JWT_SECRET and aud super-admin; static asset bypass only for /_next/ and an explicit list of files in public/ (no `pathname.includes(".")`).

Replace every remaining src/app/api/** route that touches MASTER_DB with a call to the backend admin endpoint R111 ported (tenants list/detail/status/plan/features/caps, dashboard, reports, subscriptions, audit-log, system-health). Tenant creation wizard posts to backend POST /admin/tenants (R104) and shows the temporary password once with a copy button and the provisioning status (polling GET /admin/tenants/:id/provisioning; "Deploy needed" banner for pending_deploy; Retry on failed). The wizard steps read plans from GET /admin/plans (R109); delete PLANS from src/lib/constants.ts. Remove the MASTER_DB and R2_BUCKET bindings from wrangler.toml once nothing uses them.
Hide announcements, support and SEO pages from the sidebar and redirect their routes to the dashboard (owner question Q8; leave the files in place with a comment).

Catalogue page (new, super-admin/src/app/(authenticated)/catalogue/page.tsx): edit plans and features, yearly price per market and currency, included users, extra-user price, monthly AI credits and communication caps, provider unit costs and margin (default 20%) with the computed top-up prices shown live, and add-on products, through R109's /admin/catalogue endpoints. Tenant detail page: usage per channel (GET /admin/tenants/:id/usage), Grant add-on (extra users, AI credit pack, SMS/WhatsApp/OTP/call-minute pack; note required) through POST /admin/tenants/:id/addons, the pending upgrade/top-up requests from R110, and impersonation (reason required).

OpenNext: add open-next.config.ts (defineCloudflareConfig defaults), package.json scripts "preview": "opennextjs-cloudflare build && opennextjs-cloudflare preview", "deploy": "opennextjs-cloudflare build && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy", "cf-typegen"; wrangler.toml becomes the OpenNext Workers shape (main = ".open-next/worker.js", [assets] directory = ".open-next/assets", compatibility_flags nodejs_compat) instead of pages_build_output_dir. Remove next-on-pages references from super-admin. (CI and terraform are R118.)

Desktop: delete desktop/src/app/(app)/super-admin/** and the superAdminNav entry plus its titles in nav-config.ts (and its test); delete or rewrite desktop/e2e/super-admin.spec.ts to assert /super-admin redirects to /dashboard (skip count in FINAL-E2E included one super-admin skip). Remove desktop API helpers used only by those pages (grep "/admin/" in desktop/src/lib/api).
README.md for super-admin: how to run locally against fix-stack (BACKEND_API_URL=http://localhost:8797/api/v1, create the first super admin with backend/scripts/create-super-admin.mjs --local).
tests: super-admin has no test runner today; add none. Verification is the SA gate (tsc, lint, next build) plus `npm run preview` smoke: start fix-stack slot 1 (multi), run create-super-admin --local, start `npm run preview` in super-admin with BACKEND_API_URL pointing at slot 1, log in, create an agency, see the temporary password, suspend and reactivate it. Record the steps and results in the report.
desktop: nav-config.test.ts updated; super-admin.spec.ts asserts the redirect.
acceptance: `grep -rn "getCloudflareContext" super-admin/src` finds nothing (all data via backend).
Creating an agency in the console produces a login that works in the desktop app (manual smoke recorded).
The desktop app has no /super-admin pages.
gate: cd super-admin && npx tsc --noEmit && npm run lint && npm run build
cd desktop && npx tsc --noEmit && npx tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json --noEmit
cd desktop && npx vitest run   # pass: 0 failing files, passed >= last merged count (1294 on 2026-10-14)
cd desktop && E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3110 E2E_API_URL=http://localhost:8797/api/v1 npx playwright test e2e/super-admin.spec.ts e2e/auth-shell.spec.ts
goLiveVerify: OpenNext deploy to Workers with the admin custom domain; SUPER_ADMIN_JWT_SECRET identical in backend and console.
notes: Before editing read: this batch file, docs/readiness/READINESS-PLAN.md sections 0 and the design note for this area, desktop/audit/fix/FIX-PLAN.md sections 3-4 (executor rules, worktree bootstrap with node_modules junctions; never npm install inside a worktree unless the batch adds a dependency, and then only in the main checkout by the orchestrator).

Desktop UI follows desktop/audit/remake/CONTRACT.md: ds-* indigo tokens only (no raw palette classes or hex), archetypes (ListPage/EntityForm/DetailPage or PageContainer + PageHeader), FilterBar + useInfiniteScroll for lists, RelationCombobox for relations, PhoneInput for phones, useConfirm instead of window.confirm, graceful degradation when an env key is missing. lint-gate must not rise for any file you touch.
super-admin has its own design (not CONTRACT.md); keep its existing look.

super-admin/package-lock.json is deleted by R118, not here; do not run npm install inside super-admin/ (that operates on the root workspace and can wipe the root node_modules, coordinator note 2026-10-14). If @opennextjs/cloudflare needs a version bump, stop and ask.
